board: Sikkim High Court Vacancy 2026 - 6 IT Assistant, Developer and More PostsSikkim High Court Vacancy 2026
title: IT Assistant, Developer and More
qualification: BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc with specialization in Computer Science / Electronics / IT from a recognized institution with a minimum of 02 years experience in software development including application design, development, testing and maintenance.
age_limit: Not less than 18 years of age as on the first day of January of the recruitment year i.e., 01.01.2026 and not more than 30 years of age on the last day of submission of Application Form. Relaxation of upper age limit shall be the same as may be prescribed by the State Government from time to time.
selection_process: The examinations for the concerned posts will be held in the following manner viz., Written Examination, Practical Test, followed by Interview / viva-voce. Candidates securing 40% or more marks in the Written Examination shall be eligible to appear in the Practical Test. Candidates securing 40% or more marks in the Practical Test shall be eligible to appear in the Interview / Viva-Voce. Final selection will be made on the basis of the combined marks secured by the candidates in the Written Examination, Practical Test and Interview / viva-voce. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of over-all performance of the candidates.

qualification: A Master’s degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university.
